title: Arabic Grammar ii
mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ refers to two or more figures in English usage.
Plural refers to two or more figures in English usage.
Fill in the blank: ______ is known as mushaddad and it is obtained from merging two identical letters - one silent and the other bearing a vowel - together.
A doubled consonant is known as mushaddad and it is obtained from merging two identical letters - one silent and the other bearing a vowel - together.
Fill in the blank: ______ is an important aspect of Arabic grammar as it guides in determining the appropriate status of a word within a sentence.
Vocalization is an important aspect of Arabic grammar as it guides in determining the appropriate status of a word within a sentence.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the predicate of the sentence in a nominative case.
The clause is the predicate of the sentence in a nominative case.
fib: ______ are the ones that cannot stand alone meaningfully.
The attached pronouns are the ones that cannot stand alone meaningfully.
______ is an integral aspect of Arabic grammar as it guides in determining the appropriate status of a word within a sentence.
Vowelization of lexical items is an integral aspect of Arabic grammar as it guides in determining the appropriate status of a word within a sentence.
______ is the letter ya' ( ) يas notable in the example.
The secondary vowel applicable is the letter ya' ( ) يas notable in the example.
______ is defined as a noun in the accusative case indicating the particular thing on which the action of the doer (the subject الفاعل- ) occurs.
The object is defined as a noun in the accusative case indicating the particular thing on which the action of the doer (the subject الفاعل- ) occurs.
